text.text_excerpt: Yet another new hotel stay for me in NOLA - this time at the Maison Dupuy. Location: two blocks from Bourbon but in a residential area so not too loud. Easily walk to anywhere in the Quarter and also easy to get a Lyft when needed. Also, only like a block to Bayona which is an excellent restaurant that you should totally visit. Staff: check in was easy and quick. I needed a blanket for the bed and they sent up a little comforter with no issues. They also suggested some late night delivery options since room service stops at 10pm. Some staff were more friendly than others, but they were all competent and that's what counts. I recently stayed at the Maison Dupuy Hotel, and was very pleased with the service and accommodations that were provided for our 4 day/3 night stay. Our early check in was no issue at all, and we were quickly provided a room upon our arrival, which was fantastic after and early morning flight. The room was clean, very nice and well made, with a limited but nice view of the inner courtyard. While I would I have liked a Balcony or Street side view, I believe those were for single beds and suites, of which I was neither (2 bed room requested). For location alone, this hotel is everything you could ask for and more. Quiet and charming, yet steps from all the fun, history and antics of the French Quarter. The concierge was lovely and we were able to check in a bit early, which made a world of difference after a 5:30am flight. As far as amenities go, it's a bit dated but I found the room totally charming. It was CLEAN (the bathroom still smelled like bleach) which is so appreciated. The hotel had the most gorgeous terrace and pool area where we were able to relax one afternoon with a cocktail in hand, thanks to the adjacent bar/restaurant.
